title: Concurrency and memory limits derived from hardware
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. max_concurrent_agents, gemi_max_concurrent_requests, kv_cache_capacity_tokens and thread counts computed from cores, RAM and VRAM at startup. Tests zc_limits_derived_*.
